migrationRules.name: move_address_fields_to_address
migrationRules.expr: $merge([$sift($, function($v, $k) {$k != 'address_line1' and $k != 'address_line2' and $k != 'city' and $k != 'state' and $k != 'postal_code' and $k != 'country'}), {'address': {'address_line1': address_line1, 'address_line2': address_line2, 'city': city, 'state': state, 'postal_code': postal_code, 'country': country}}])

migrationRules.name: move_address_to_address_fields
migrationRules.expr: $merge([$sift($, function($v, $k) {$k != 'address'}), {'address_line1': address.address_line1, 'address_line2': address.address_line2, 'city': address.city, 'state': address.state, 'postal_code': address.postal_code, 'country': address.country}])
